# verify/emit/dashboard

`verify/emit/dashboard` — the proof report as a 70-column box: each
function's Hoare triple, one mark per postcondition, the counterexamples
and hazards the solver found, the float64 gate's findings, and a verdict.
Widths count code points, so the box lines up in a terminal.

Generated from [src/verify/emit/dashboard.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/verify/emit/dashboard.ts).

### STATUS_PROVEN

Every postcondition is proven, meaningfully, with no hazard.

```ts
const STATUS_PROVEN: string = "PROVEN"
```

<a id="status_refuted"></a>

### STATUS_REFUTED

The solver or the float64 gate found a defect.

```ts
const STATUS_REFUTED: string = "REFUTED"
```

<a id="status_unknown"></a>

### STATUS_UNKNOWN

Some clause is undecided and nothing is refuted.

```ts
const STATUS_UNKNOWN: string = "UNKNOWN"
```

### verdictStatus

The report's verdict. Every failure except a bare solver `unknown` is a
concrete defect, so it refutes.

```ts
function verdictStatus(report: VerifyReport): string
```

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="string">

</scalar-field>

### dashWrap

Wraps text at spaces into lines of at most `width` code points; a word
longer than `width` gets a line of its own.

